notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Some minor changes here, focused mainly on bugs and performance updates., 
These will stay fairly vague as we don't want to spoil anything for anyone. 


*Fixed - Collision on the front door. Yes you could have escaped all along. 
*Fixed - Significant frame drop while using ... something upstairs. 
*Fixed - a certain destructable item not destructabling.
*Fixed - Rare bug where players were getting teleported to a different house

We'll continue to make improvements and adjustments as time goes on, and player feedback keeps coming in.
